# BOM, drift check and sync: is this moment mine?

## What this region is

One @inixiative/config version names one coherent set of toolchain pins and @inixiative/* versions (versions.json, the BOM); this Warden covers that manifest, the drift rules that hold one repo or every checkout under a root to it, the bin surface that runs them, and the reusable CI workflow that enforces them.

## What it exists for

- Find or record which versions the inixiative packages are blessed at
- Record a version or repo that is not a plain blessed entry
- While changing the CLI, read lanes and blessed sets (internal; app code imports @inixiative/config/versions.json)
- Find or fix a repo's drift from the BOM
- Understand why check failed on a dependency, the toolchain or the repo layout
- Look across every inixiative checkout on this machine
- Run or extend the inixiative-config command line

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- publish the new version and move every dependent onto it → release-train
- keep a breaking major out of the blessed set for now → release-train
- CI fails on an old product name in the README → retired-terms
- extend the shared tsconfig and biome config in a new package → toolchain-presets
- which local port should this project's api run on → port-registry
